1.2 CONDITIONS FOR INSTALLATION AND OPERATION AND OPERATION FILLINGS  
1.2.1 Location. 
Pump JETS 3.8/60-COMPACT is determined for indoor and ventilated or compulsorily ventilated 
environment with permanent temperature from +10°C to +30°C and humidity 50% at the temperature of 
+30°C and altitudinal height up to 1000 above sea level. For air renewal for cooling of oil and the 
electromotor it is necessary to observe the minimum distance from the left part of the pump from any 
obstacle of 550 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400mm at the rare side of the pump. The necessary 
distance from the right side and from the front side of the pump is 1100mm for operation and control of the 
distributor. To prevent leakage of oil to the indoor environment it is necessary to provide the floor and walls 
of the machine room with antiskid coating which is resistant to oil substances up to the minimum height of 
250 mm above the floor. Necessary floor capacity for the installation is 9000 kg/m². The surface, on which 
the high-pressure pump shall be installed, must not show the roughness higher than 10mm/m² (±5mm/m²). 
Producer strictly recommends locating the high-pressure pump JETS 3.8/60-COMPACT to a separate 
machine room to prevent excessive noisiness in the workplace, cleanness at the maintenance and service 
and safety at work. The ideal location of the machine is drawn on the picture of sample layout of the pump 
(serial number: PTV-011-V-0190). The pump is equipped with an air-cooler of the hydraulic oil, which is 
integrated in the machine. The machine must not be exposed to the microwave, ultraviolet, laser or roentgen 
rays. The machine shall be separated from the floor by means of rubber silentblocks; vibrations of other 
machines transmitted by the floor on which the machine is placed shall have negative influence on the 
lifetime of individual elements of the machine. Storage of the machine is possible in a dry environment with 
temperature ranging between +5°C and +35°C and in a suitable packing. Manipulation with the machine may 
be carried out only by means of a lift-truck; two openings are in the bottom part of the frame. These are 
designed for lifting forks of the truck. Any other method of manipulation is not allowed.  
1.2.2 Power supplies. 
According to the drawing no. PTV-011-V-0190. 
Water supply for cutting (Water supply „A“): it is necessary to use only clean filtered water or potable water 
from the water feeder. The maximum consumption of water is 4.0 l/min. The maximum pressure of input 
water is 6bar, the minimum pressure is 3.5bar and value of pH is 6-8. The connecting point has to be 
installed 1m from the floor level and ended with closing valve G3/4“ with internal thread. This water will be 
used to supply the high-pressure pump JETS 3.8/60-COMPACT. The ideal place of installation of the supply 
is marked on the picture „Sample layout of the machine room“ (see drawing no. PTV-011-V-0190). 
Water outlet from the pump: this waste water must be drained to a tank, because the water may be mixed 
here with the hydraulic oil. After this tank is filled, it is necessary to liquidate it ecologically. The connection of 
the drain has to be installed from 150 to 500mm from the floor level and ended by external thread G3/4“. The 
ideal place of installation of this supply is marked on the picture of sample layout of the machine room 
(drawing number: PTV-011-V-0190). 
Connection of power supply („A“): the rated input of the pump is 37 kW, the supply voltage 3x400/230V; 
50Hz, the electric input of the cooler is 1.5 kW, knife fuses 80A are installed in the main distributor. The 
distributor has to be placed on the wall of the room according valid regulations for electric devices of this 
type. Electric distributors of the machine are located in the side part of the machine in a metal box.  
Connection of the pump to the electric network may be made by the cable CYKY 4x25mm² or 5x25mm² in 
the length of the cable up to 15 meters and if longer, the cable CYKY 4x35mm² or 5x35mm² shall be 
used. Supply protection must be made by the circuit breaker or fuses with the rated value of 100A at the 
execution of the supply with cable 4x25mm²(5x25mm²) or 125A at the execution of the supply with 
cable 4x35mm²(5x35mm²). The electric power supply must be made in a distance of 2500mm from the 
machine room floor at least. The ideal place of installation of this connection is marked on the picture of the 
sample layout of the machine room (serial number: PTV-011-V-0190) and it should be always in the 
immediate proximity of the distributor. Operator of the machine is obliged to carry the yellow-green wire 
CYA 16mm² to the main distributor for execution of the central connection of the electric system.  
Power supply („B“): in this place it is necessary to attach the socket 3x400/230V; 50Hz; 25A on the wall of 
the machine room and a socket 230V; 50Hz; 25A for necessary assembly, service, maintenance and 
auxiliary works.. 
Outlet of the high-pressure water from the pump: any heat influence caused by any external source may 
result in the change of material structure of the high-pressure water part and its devaluation this way – avoid 
working with heat sources (welding machine, oxyacetylene burner, etc.) in the near proximity of these parts. 
This output and distribution of the high pressure water has to be regularly checked for leakages of water.  
Any interferences, maintenance, and service of the electric connection and the 
supply must be carried out only by a person with electrical qualification 
(according the Czech public notice no. 50/78 Col., article 6). Service and repairs 
of the machine are permitted only with the consent of the producer. In case of 
 an unauthorized intervention to the connection and setting of the electric 
distributions the users shall loose the guarantee provided by the producer!

1.2.3 Operation fillings. 
Operation filling of the pump is the hydraulic oil OHHM 46, SHELL TELLUS 46 or Chevron hydraulic AW-46, 
Exxon Nuto H-46, Texaco Rando HD-46. The net volume of the tank is 210 l. For change of oil it is 
necessary to prepare approximately 170 l of oil. When filling the tank it is necessary to use the filling filtering 
mean with the final minimum filtration 5 µm. Change of the hydraulic oil must be carried out precisely 
according the operation instructions and pay attention to the maximum cleanness. At the change of oil it is 
necessary to dispose off the used oil filling ecologically. The maximum operating pressure of the hydraulic oil 
is 215 bar. 
All necessary data and proposal for location of the machine is shown on the picture 
of the sample layout of the pump (drawing no. PTV-011-V-0190). Installation, 
assembly, putting the machine to operation and training of operators shall be 
provided exclusively by the producer or the supplier of the machine! 
 
1.3 MACHINE CAPACITY AND REQUIREMENTS FOR OPERATION  
The stable high-pressure pump JETS - 3.8/60-COMPACT with the fitted multiplier of type „60K“ 3.8 l/min 
delivers the water at the maximum pressure 4100 bar. This device serves for cutting of material by means of 
a water jet. For operation and maintenance of this machine it is necessary to train one operator (training of 
the operator must be carried out by the producer of the machine), who will learn the safety instructions 
related to this machine as well. These instructions are included in this manual. This operator must keep the 
machine in clean and functional condition and check the observance of safety and operation 
instructions by other workers who move around the machine as well.    
 
1.4 MACHINE DESCRIPTION  
1.4.1 Hydraulic part. 
Scheme of this part creates the appendix of this manual – see drawing no. PTV-011-D-0173. 
-Electromotor (note1 - M1) powers the hydraulic pump 
-Suction filter (note 23 - SF) serves for filtration of oil sucked by the hydraulic pump 
-Hydraulic pump (note 4 - P) supplies necessary pressure and quantity of hydraulic oil for the multiplier. 
-Hydraulic distribution box (notes 5 and 42 – HK1 and 2) serves as a holder and distribution for other 
hydraulic elements. 
 
-Safety valve (note 9 - PV) protects the pump and the multiplier against possible overpressure in the 
distribution. 
-Proportional valve (note 46 - PPV) controlled by the electronic unit; ensures smooth functioning of the pump 
and correct output parameters of the hydraulic oil; it is integrated directly on the hydraulic pump. 
 
-Closing electromagnetic valve (note 45 - EV) ensures closing of delivery of the hydraulic pump. 
 
-Electromagnetic distributor (note 6 - DEV) ensures operation of bleed down valve (note 27 – BD) at the 
reduction of output water pressure. 
 
-Panel of choke valves with check valves (note 8 - DSV) reduces the speed of oil flow from and to the bleed 
down valve. 
 
-Panel of check valve (note 7 – DZV) ensures correct direction of hydraulic oil flow for control of the bleed 
down valve. 
-Manometer (note 44 – MP2) serves for measuring of pressure on the output of the hydraulic pump and 
setting of its working level.  
-Choke valve (note 43 - SV) limits vibration of manometer hand at the operation of the machine. 
-Pressure sensor (note 10 – P1) reads the pressure of hydraulic oil on the output of the pump and delivers 
this information to the automatic control.  
-Bleed down valve (note 27 - BD) ensures reduction of pressure from the high pressure pump conduct at the 
reduction of the pressure and the machine standstill.  
-Multiplier (note 25 - VTM) by means of hydraulic oil pressure (max. 215 bar) increases the water pressure to 
the maximum pressure of 4100 bar (with the multiplier type 60K). Number of presets of multiplier at the 
operation of the machine is namely 80/min (max. 110/min). 
-Hydraulic oil cooler (note 24 - CH) by means of ventilator, own circulatory pump and electromotor (M2) cools 
the hydraulic oil to the appropriate operation temperature (approximately 50°C). Hydraulic oil cooler is 
integrated in the machine.  
-Reverse filter (note 15 - ZF) ensures fine filtration (10µm) of hydraulic oil before it enters to the tank. 
-Filler (note13 - NZ) ensures safe filling of the tank with the hydraulic oil. 
-Tank (note 19 - N) ensures sufficient operation stock of hydraulic oil (approximately 160 l). 
-Openings (note 18 - PN) allow access to inside of the tank. 
-Ball valves (note 21 – KV2) ensure safe draining of the oil filling from the tank and closing of suction 
conduction. 
-Oil level sensor (note 17 – L1) allows automatic putting the machine out of operation at the decrease of oil 
level under the critical level. 
-Local thermometer and level indicator (note 12 – T2+L2) allow visual checking of temperature and level of 
oil in the tank.

Filtering unit (note 30 – FJ): 
-Manometers at the input and output (note 32 – MP1) measure the input and output pressure of the filtering

-Ball valves (note 31 - V) allow closing of water supply to the multiplier and serve as the prevention against

-Filter (note 33 – FV1) filters water to the mechanical cleanness < 1µm

-Increase of input water pressure (note 36 – TVV) – shall be delivered on request:

1.4.3 High-pressure part. 
Scheme of this part creates the annex of this manual – see drawing number: PTV-011-D-0173. 
-Multiplier (note 25 - VTM) increases pressure of water to the required level – the machine is standardly fitted

-Bleed down valve (note 27 - BD) at the requirement for low input pressure of water ensures decrease of

-Temperature sensor (note 28 – T5) indicates the temperature of the bleed down valve on the control panel.  
-Temperature sensor (note 26 – T3, T4) indicates temperature of check valves on the control panel.

2. MACHINE FUNCTION DESCRIPTION 
2.1 Hydraulic part. 
Scheme of this part creates the Annex of this manual – see drawing number: PTV-011-D-0173. 
Electromotor (note 1 – M1) is connected by means of a fitting (note 3 – S) and a holder (note 2 – D) with the 
hydraulic pump (note 3 - P) and it powers it. Suction of the hydraulic pump is realized through the suction 
filter (note 23 – SF) in the tank (note 19 - N) and it is possible to close the suction by means of the slide 
valve (note 22 – SO1). A proportional valve (note 46 – PPV is fitted on the pump (note 4 – P) which controls 
the pressure level on the output from the pump based on a signal from the electronic module and the 
automatic control. The output from the pump is fitted with hydraulic distribution boxes (notes 5 and 42 – HK1 
and HK2). The safety valve (note 9 – PV) is installed in HK1. It ensures the delivery of the pump in case the 
maximum preset pressure is exceeded and it serves as the safety element as well. Waste from the safety 
valve is drained directly to the tank by means of T-piece through the ball valve (note 21 – KV2). The HK2 is 
fitted with electromagnetic valve (note 45 – EV), this valve ensures closing of the pump delivery and it 
separates it this way from the multiplier. This closing is important at the pressure level 0 bar, because the 
pump works with the minimum pressure – approximately 30 bar. The HK2 is further fitted with control 
elements of the bleed down valve – panel of the check valve (note 7 – DZC), panel of the butterfly valves 
(note 8 – DSV) and electromagnetic distributor (note 9 – DEV). All these elements ensure smooth operation 
of the bleed down valve at the reduction of pressure level and putting the pump out of operation. Waste from 
these elements is drained to the waste line of the pump (leakage) by means of T-pieces. The pressure 
sensor (note 10 – P1) is connected to the HK2. It reads the real pressure of the hydraulic oil. The signal is 
being transmitted to the automatic control and based on this information the device controls the proportional 
valve. The local manometer (note 44 – MP2) is connected by means of the T-piece to the HK2. It serves for 
the informational measuring of the real pressure of the hydraulic oil. The butterfly valve (note 43 – SV) is 
placed in front of the manometer. It softens pressure jumps and prevents excessive vibration of the 
manometer hand. The main pressure line leads from HK2. The pump delivers necessary quantity and the oil 
pressure for the multiplier (note 25 – VTM). The waste hose (so called leakage) leads from the pump as well. 
It leads directly to the tank of the hydraulic oil and it is connected to the T-piece inside the emptying ball 
valve (note 21 – KV2) and then to the tank. The main pressure line brings the necessary pressure and 
quantity of hydraulic oil to the multiplier and the multiplier subsequently increases water pressure to the 
required level. The waste oil from the multiplier is drained to the tank through the reverse filter (note 15 – 
ZF), which ensures the fine filtration of the oil and protects this way the system against dirt and excessive 
wear caused by the dirt. The reverse filter is fitted with the pressure switch (note 15 – P3) which indicates 
pollution of the filter and reports the need to change the cartridge to the control panel. Cooling of the 
hydraulic oil proceeds in the closed circuit by means of air cooler (note 24 – CH) which ensures the right 
operation temperature of the oil. Electromotor of the cooler (M2) is being switched on and of from the 
automatic control which ensures current temperature by means of temperature sensor (note 16 – T1) fitted 
on the tank, the automatic control evaluates and switches on or off the cooler electromotor. The cooler has 
its own circulatory pump and it is possible to close the cooling circle by means of ball valves (notes 20 and 
21 – KV1 and KV2) to separate tanks this way. This shall be used at the servicing of the cooling circle. The 
tank of the hydraulic oil is further fitted with the surface switch (note 17 – L1), which protects the hydraulic 
circle against the damage by the oil leakage. Further there is the filler (note 13 – NZ) which ensures 
functioning of the filtered deaeration and possibility of safe filling of the tank with the oil. Another elements of 
the tank are openings (note 18 – PN) which serve for cleaning of the tank at the change of oil and the local 
level indicator and the thermometer (note 12 – L2, T2) – information meters for operation of the machine.    
2.2 Part of water supply to multipliers – filtering unit and increase of input water pressure. 
Scheme of this part creates the Annex of this manual – see drawing number PTV-011-D-0173. 
Filtering unit (note 30 – FJ): 
Water pressure at the input and output from the filtering unit is being measured by manometers (note 32 – 
MP1), which measure pollution of filters in the unit by optic difference of pressures. Supply of water to 
multipliers is lead through the ball valve (note 31 – KV3) which serves as a prevention against leakage of 
water when changing filters and then to own filters (note 33 – FV1 and 34 – FV0.5) in which the final filtration 
of water up to the level < 0.5µm is carried out. Before the water enters the multiplier the sensor of input water 
pressure (note 35 – P2) is fitted in the line which in case of pressure decreases under the critical level stops 
the machine and reports this action by lighting up the pilot light on the control panel.  
Increasing of pressure of input water (note 36 – TVV) – shall be delivered on request: 
This compact water feeder is fitted with own pump (note 37 – PV) which is powered by electromotor (note 38 
– M3).  
The electromotor is being put into operation by means of pressure switch (note 39 – P3) at the decrease of 
water pressure under the minimum level. This switch may be mounted as a part of the filtering unit as well. 
The water is pressurized to the tank with bag (note 40 – TN), in which a sufficient stock of water with 
required pressure will be maintained. The pressure is maintained in the tank by means of air pressure from 
the second part of the bag. This air pressure may be checked and replenished by means of little pressure 
valve (note 41 – TV). To prevent leakage of water when the machine was stopped the electromagnetic stop 
valve (note 47 – EVV) is mounted in the filtering unit. It closes the supply to multiplier by pressing the stop 
button.

2.3 High-pressure part. 
The water from the filtering unit is carried by hoses to the multiplier (note 12 - VTM) where the pressure is 
being increased up to the maximum pressure of 4100 bar (60K). The HP water is carried to the 
countervailing cylinder (note 48 – VTV) which softens hydraulic impacts in the pipe. Behind the cylinder there 
is the output of the water to the supply pipe of the cutting place. The bleed down valve (note 27 – BD) is 
parallelly connected to this output. The bleed down valve functions as the depressurizing element for

3.2 Putting the machine into operation. 
NOTICE: the first initiation of the machine may be carried out only by a professional 
engineer of the producer of the device! First initiation of the machine and further 
starting after the change of oil of after longer shutdown of the machine it is 
necessary to carry out following procedures:  
1. It is necessary to fill in the oil pump with the hydraulic oil to its delivery and to the filler of the waste line – 
leakage (when hoses are disconnected), otherwise it may result in a serious damage of this pump. Then the 
hoses may be connected again.  
2. Fill in the tank with the hydraulic oil, approximately 5 mm under the upper level of the local level indicator.  
3. Open the water input to the multiplier, disconnect the supply hoses to the multiplier, and let the water off 
for 3 minutes at least to wash up dirt from supply hoses.  
4. Close the water supply and connect hoses to the multiplier. 
5. Check visually the entire machine for any oil and water leakages – in case of need to remove defects by 
tightening of hoses.. 
6. Open the water supply to multipliers and make sure by means of manometer on the control panel that the 
water pressure is sufficient and that water filters are not polluted.  
7. Close the HP valve on the HP water supply to the cutting workplace. 
!!!ATTENTION!!! BEFORE EACH START OF THE MACHINE CHECK BALL VALVES 
AND THE SLIDE VALVE ON THE BUTTOM PART OF THE TANK – ALL MUST BE 
OPEN IN FULL BEFORE THE PUMP STARTS. OTHERWISE A SERIOUS DAMAGE OF 
THE HYDRALIC PUMP AND THE CIRCULATORY PUMP OF THE COOLER MAY 
HAPPEN !!! 
8. Switch the main switch on the main distributor on. 
9. Press the START button and the machine will starts operating. Press the STOP button after approximately 
10 seconds. Repeat this procedure 4 times at least so that hydraulic circuits smoothly fill with the oil. Then 
start the machine with START button.  
10. Wait until the operation of the machine becomes stable and concurrently make visual check of all its 
parts. Press button „1“ on the control panel. This way you will let the hydraulic oil flow to the multiplier at the 
approximate pressure of 30 bar. Wait until the operation of the machine is stable.  
11. Open slowly the HP valve on the HP supply to the cutting workplace and let the water to flow to the HP 
distribution system.  
12. Open the ON/OFF valve on the cutting table and leave the HP water to flow freely through the water jet

pump. In case of use of larger nozzle the pump may be damaged!  
13. Pressing the button „2“ on the control panel you increase the HO pressure to approximately 51 bar. 
14. Leave the machine in operation at this pressure for approximately 5 minutes. Concurrently carry out 
visual check of the whole machine. 
15. Pressing the button „4“ on the control panel you increase the HO pressure to approximately 103 bar. 
16. Leave the machine in operation for approximately 5 minutes. In case of any prove of possible failure, 
leakage of liquids or irregular operation, stop the machine immediately. 
17. Pressing the button „6“ on the control panel you increase the HO pressure to approximately 138 bar. 
18. Leave the machine in operation for approximately 5 minutes. In case of any prove of possible failure, 
leakage of liquids or irregular operation, stop the machine immediately.

The check valves are contained in a two-piece unit in the end cap. The components of the check 
valve are shown below. When the check valves require service, one or more of the following 
conditions are usually present. 
a) High-pressure water temperature at the outlet fitting exceeds 120°F (49°C) indicating excessive 
back-flow through the outlet check valve. 
b) Hydraulic piston slams to the end of travel indicating excessive back-flow through the inlet check 
valve. 
c)  Repetitive spiking of the high-pressure water pressure indicating that one or both of the valves      
may be leaking excessively. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
1.  
Shut down the systém. Disconnect the supply water hose at the quick-disconnect fitting and, 
using two wrenches, disconnect the high-pressure water line from the check valve outlet 
body. Loosen the other end of the tubing and move the tubing out of the way. Using two 
wrenches remove the outlet body. The outlet body contains the outlet poppet and a spring. 
Remove the insert from the main body. Note that the lapped surface is visible when the insert 
is in place. 
 
 
 
 
2.  
Note the orientation of the main check valve body, then loosen the end cap by tapping the 
spanner wrench with a mallet. If required, remove the cable guides, then restrain the high-
pressure water cylinder with a strap or girth wrench. Unscrew the end cap from the cylinder 
by hand, ensuring that the check valve assembly rotates with the end cap as an asembly. 
Failure to rotate the check valve assembly with the end cap may damage the o-rings located 
on the check valve body. Use a wrench if required to ensure that the check valve rotates with 
the end cap. Check the corners of the wrench flats on the main body. All burrs must be filed 
off to prevent scratching the end cap bore during removal. Using your thumbs, press the 
check valve main body out through the end cap. The only resistance you should feel is when 
the o-rings on the main body contact the inner bore of the end cap.

Machine - 
type 
High-pressure units FLOW type 5X, 7X, 20X. In pressure ranges 40.000 PSI, 
55.000 PSI, 60.000 PSI and CNC table with a high-pressure water jet (WJ) 
technology 
Noisiness: 
Units and pump are the source of noise. By an objective measurement of noise 
pollution carried out by a person accredited for authorized noised measurement 
through measuring techniques complying with requirements defined for precision 
class 1, the following was proved: 
An equivalent level of acoustic noise A at values 88.7 dB is generated over a 
long-term operation in a closed machine-room bay of the JETS 3.8/60  type of 
pump. The machine-room, and/or pump are operated unattended. At full output 
and for 8-hour shift, a full-shift exposure of an attendant indicates a value of an 
equivalent level of acoustic pressure A – 80.1 dB, which is in compliance even if 
usual measurement uncertainties E = 1.6 dB are taken into consideration, with a 
sufficient allowance for requirements determined to hygienic limits set out in the 
Governmental Regulation No. 148/2006 Coll. on protection of health against 
adverse noise and vibration effects. (Remark: subject to the recommendation of 
the World Health Organization, the same hygienic limits de facto apply in most 
states). 
Dust 
nuisance: 
No dust is produced when the unit is in operation. 
General 
safety: 
The unit and CNC tables are designed as per ČSN EN ISO 12100-1 (83 3001) 
Machine and Equipment Safety - Basic Terms, General Design Principles and 
ČSN EN ISO 12100-2 Machine and Equipment Safety – Basic Terms, General 
Design Principles – Part 2: Technical Principles. Maximum available level of 
safety is therefore provided when the device is used in compliance with 
instructions. Residual risks are acceptable. 
Electrical 
safety:  
 
Electrical equipment of units and CNC tables are designed as per ČSN EN 
60204-1 (33 2200) – March 2000. Safety of Machine and Equipment – Electrical 
Equipment of Machines - Part 1: General Requirements. This standard is a Czech 
version of the European standard EN 60204:1997 including amendments from 
September 1998. European standard EN 60204:1997 has a status of a Czech 
technical standard. The unit has undergone initial revision of electrical 
installation as per ČSN 33 1500 Electrical Engineering Directives. Revision of 
Electrical Equipment. Environment as regards electrical equipment "basic, 
normal" is in accordance with ČSN 33 2000-3 - AA4, AB4, AB5, XX1, for 
external effects AC to AR (except of AQ), BA1, BC1, BC2, BD1, BE1, CA1, 
CB1; as well as BA4, BA5

Not relevant for this type of equipment
